name: AEOLynx – AI Search Tracking, AEO, GEO, LLMs.txt, WebMCP & Answer Engine Optimization
author: N4nion

sections.description:
Get discovered, tracked, and cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. AEOLynx is a 100% free, unlocked AI Search Tracking, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), llms.txt, AI Markdown, Schema.org JSON-LD, and WebMCP plugin built for WordPress — running locally on your own server with zero telemetry and zero bloat.

Works seamlessly alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress, and WooCommerce. Keep your existing SEO plugin for XML sitemaps and meta titles while AEOLynx handles the AI search visibility layer — with granular toggles so you never emit duplicate Schema.org markup or conflicting robots.txt rules.

Video walkthrough: activating AEOLynx, running the 24-point Agent-Ready Audit, exploring the Agent Sandbox, and inspecting live /llms.txt and MCP endpoints.

AI Search Tracking & Free Local Prompt Opportunity Miner

Stop guessing what buyers ask AI assistants before choosing a brand. AEOLynx includes a dedicated AI Search Tracking screen right inside wp-admin that runs 100% locally with zero API keys and zero external calls:

  • Local Prompt Opportunity Miner (Pass 1 Free) — Automatically scans your published posts, pages, WooCommerce products, H2/H3 question headings, categories, and FAQPage metadata to uncover real buyer-intent prompts (Transactional, Comparison, How-To / FAQ, and Category / Authority).
  • Relevance & Commercial Value Scoring — Every discovered prompt includes relevance and buyer-value scores plus a direct link to the source page on your site.
  • 1-Click Perplexity, ChatGPT & Claude Checks — Copy any mined prompt or launch a live manual check in Perplexity, ChatGPT, or Claude with one click to see if your brand is mentioned or cited.
  • Optional Pro Companion Integration — Automatically connects with the separate AEOLynx Pro companion plugin when installed for scheduled weekly BYOK multi-engine visibility tracking across Perplexity, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and custom endpoints.

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for WordPress

  • Page AEO X-Ray Scanner & 1-Click Answer-Gap FAQ Injector — Score any published post, page, or product (0–100, Grade A+ to C), preview the exact Speakable passages AI answer engines will quote, edit 4 high-intent Answer-Gap questions inline, and inject non-duplicate FAQPage schema in one click.
  • Connected Schema.org JSON-LD @graph — Outputs Organization or Person, WebSite (with GET SearchAction), WebPage (with SpeakableSpecification), BreadcrumbList, Article (BlogPosting, Article, NewsArticle, TechArticle), Auto-FAQPage from ? headings, and WooCommerce Product & Offer (InStock / OutOfStock). Includes an offline Validate tool in Settings.
  • Optional Reader “Ask AI / Cite This Page” Bar & Key Summary (TL;DR) — Off by default; enable globally or drop [aeolynx_ai_summary] into Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, or Bricks with automatic light/dark background luminance detection and 1-click ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and View AI Markdown buttons.

Works Alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress & WooCommerce

  • Toggle AEOLynx’s Schema.org @graph or virtual robots.txt rules independently to complement Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), or SEOPress with zero conflicts.
  • When WooCommerce is active, product pages automatically gain rich Product / Offer JSON-LD (SKU, price, currency, stock status) and AI agents can browse your catalog via getCatalogItems.

Dynamic /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt & AI Markdown Streams

  • Spec-Compliant /llms.txt & /llms-full.txt — Generates cached llmstxt.org summary and extended corpus indexes of your published posts, pages, and products (strictly excluding drafts, private, and password-protected posts) with a live Endpoint Inspector inside the dashboard.
  • Cache-Safe Markdown for AI Agents (?format=markdown, ?format=md, Accept: text/markdown) — Converts published posts and the homepage into clean LLM-ready Markdown with YAML frontmatter. Protected by RFC 9110 q-value negotiation, Vary: Accept, Cache-Control: private, no-store on Accept-negotiated responses, and LiteSpeed_Cache_API guards so page caches are never poisoned.

Native WebMCP & Six Read-Only Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools

Expose safe, public read-only AI agent tools at /wp-json/aeolynx/v1/ plus the W3C browser document.modelContext.registerTool WebMCP bridge and complete .well-known discovery (/.well-known/mcp.json, RFC 9727 /.well-known/api-catalog, /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json + SKILL.md, /.well-known/ai-catalog.json, /auth.md, and 5 RFC 8288 HTTP Link headers):

  1. getSiteInfo — Site title, tagline, language, active theme, published counts, top categories, and AEO endpoints.
  2. searchSite — Keyword search across public posts, pages, products, and searchable custom post types.
  3. getFeaturedContent — Latest published posts with summaries, categories, and estimated reading time.
  4. getPostContent — Clean Markdown, TL;DR summary, and structured FAQs fetched by post ID, slug, or URL.
  5. getSiteTaxonomies — Categories and tags ordered by post count for topical hierarchy.
  6. getCatalogItems — Published WooCommerce products (price, currency, SKU, stock) or graceful content fallback.

Test all 6 tools or natural-language agent queries live inside the Interactive Agent Sandbox in wp-admin.

24-Point AI Agent-Ready Audit & Per-Bot Crawler Control (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot)

  • 24-Check Local Agent-Ready Audit — Probes robots.txt, sitemap, RFC 8288 Link headers, Markdown negotiation, Content Signals, .well-known manifests, WebMCP bridge, and live GPTBot edge reachability directly from your server, with 1-click JSON export and optional Cloudflare isitagentready.com verification.
  • Per-Bot AI Crawler Matrix & Content Signals — Allow or disallow OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, GPTBot, and CCBot in virtual robots.txt alongside Content-Signal (contentsignals.org) policies and 1-click presets.
  • Local AI Crawler & Tool Activity Feed — Real-time, privacy-safe log of AI bot crawls, /llms.txt reads, Markdown fetches, and MCP tool executions (capped at 60 events, write-throttled per bot/path, clearable anytime).

Privacy, Security & Developer Extensibility

  • Zero Telemetry & Zero Remote Scripts — All JS/CSS assets are bundled locally; nothing leaves your server unless you opt in and click Verify via Cloudflare.
  • Hardened Security — Optional SHA-256 hashed MCP API keys via HTTP headers only (X-WebMCP-Key, X-AEOLynx-Key, Authorization: Bearer), dual-window atomic SQL rate limiting with Retry-After headers, 4 KB payload cap, strict password-protected post isolation, and WP-CLI commands (wp aeolynx audit, status, tools, flush-cache, clear-log).
  • Developer Hooks — aeolynx_register_tools, aeolynx_call_tool, aeolynx_exclude_post, aeolynx_schema_graph, aeolynx_client_ip, aeolynx_trusted_proxies, aeolynx_core_loaded.

Project & documentation: https://wikiofautomation.com/

External services

This plugin connects to isitagentready.com (a free site-scanner operated by Cloudflare) for one optional feature: verifying your site’s agent-readiness score with a third-party audit.

  • What it is used for: an optional “Verify via Cloudflare” button on the Agent Audit admin screen. The feature is disabled by default and does nothing unless an administrator enables it and clicks the button.
  • What data is sent and when: only your site’s URL, sent once per click of the “Verify via Cloudflare” button. No other data (no user data, no content, no credentials) is transmitted.
  • The service is provided by Cloudflare, Inc. Terms of use: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/ — Privacy policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

No other external services are used. All other plugin features — including local AI Search Tracking prompt mining, Page AEO X-Ray, /llms.txt, AI Markdown streams, Schema.org JSON-LD, WebMCP tools, and the 24-check Agent-Ready Audit — run entirely on your own server.
sections.installation:
1. Install AEOLynx via Plugins → Add New (or upload aeolynx-for-webmcp to /wp-content/plugins/).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open AEOLynx for WebMCP → Overview and click Run audit to run the 24-check local Agent-Ready Audit.
  4. Open AI Search Tracking to mine buyer-intent AI search prompts from your site content and test them across Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Claude.
  5. Open X-Ray Scanner to inspect any post’s 0–100 AEO grade and fix Answer-Gap FAQs in one click, and visit Settings to configure Schema.org toggles, per-bot robots.txt rules, optional reader widgets, and API keys.
sections.faq:
How does AI Search Tracking work in AEOLynx?

Open AEOLynx for WebMCP → AI Search Tracking. The built-in Local Prompt Opportunity Miner scans your published posts, pages, WooCommerce products, H2/H3 question headings, categories, and FAQPage metadata completely locally on your WordPress server — with zero API keys and zero external calls. It scores each prompt for relevance and buyer value, lets you filter by intent (Transactional, Comparison, How-To, Category), copy prompts in one click, and open live manual checks in Perplexity, ChatGPT, or Claude.

What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?

AEO and GEO structure your WordPress site so AI answer engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews) can reliably discover, understand, and cite your pages. AEOLynx provides every foundational layer: /llms.txt, clean AI Markdown streams, connected Schema.org JSON-LD (FAQPage, SpeakableSpecification, Product/Offer), WebMCP tools, and an X-Ray scanner.

Will AEOLynx conflict with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, or SEOPress?

No. AEOLynx is designed to work alongside classic SEO plugins. Keep Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, or SEOPress for XML sitemaps, meta titles, and redirects, and use the granular switches in AEOLynx → Settings to disable any Schema.org or robots.txt overlap you do not need.

Will AEOLynx de-index my website?

No. Normal HTML pages never receive X-Robots-Tag: noindex from AEOLynx. Only machine-readable agent endpoints (/llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /.well-known/*, /auth.md, and Markdown streams) send X-Robots-Tag: noindex to prevent duplicate-content indexing.

Are password-protected, draft, or private posts exposed to AI agents?

No. All public endpoints (/llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, Markdown streams, Schema.org JSON-LD, local prompt mining, and all 6 MCP REST tools) strictly exclude password-protected, draft, pending, private, scheduled, and trashed posts. Developers can exclude additional posts with the aeolynx_exclude_post filter.

Are any features locked behind a Pro paywall?

No. Every feature included in this plugin is 100% free and unlocked in compliance with WordPress.org Guideline 5. If you separately install the optional AEOLynx Pro companion plugin for scheduled weekly multi-engine BYOK tracking, it connects via the aeolynx_render_pro_tracking_workspace action hook.

What is Model Context Protocol (MCP) and WebMCP?

MCP is an open protocol that lets AI agents call structured tools on your site (/wp-json/aeolynx/v1/ and /.well-known/mcp.json), while WebMCP exposes those read-only tools directly inside supporting browsers via document.modelContext.registerTool. AEOLynx ships 6 safe read-only discovery tools with zero risk of AI modifying your database.

How does MCP API key enforcement work?

Public read-only MCP endpoints are open by default so AI agents can discover your published content. If you enable Require API key on MCP REST endpoints in Settings, clients must authenticate via the X-WebMCP-Key, X-AEOLynx-Key, or Authorization: Bearer HTTP header (URL query-string keys are rejected for security). Keys are stored as SHA-256 hashes and shown only once.

Does AEOLynx require WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce support is completely optional. When WooCommerce is active, product pages emit Product/Offer JSON-LD and getCatalogItems returns live SKU, price, currency, and stock status. Without WooCommerce, getCatalogItems gracefully falls back to published posts and pages.

Does this plugin track visitors or send data externally?

No. Zero telemetry and zero remote scripts or CDNs. The only optional external call is the Cloudflare isitagentready.com verification button on the Agent Audit screen, which is off by default and sends only your public site URL when an administrator opts in and clicks Verify.
sections.changelog:
1.5.1

  • New — AI Search Tracking & Free Local Prompt Opportunity Miner: Added the AI Search Tracking screen (AEOLynx for WebMCP → AI Search Tracking) that mines buyer-intent prompts locally from your public posts, pages, WooCommerce products, H2/H3 question headings, categories, and FAQPage metadata (zero API keys, zero external calls) with intent filters, relevance & buyer-value scores, 1-click Copy, and direct Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Claude test links.
  • New — Pro Workspace Bridge & Dashboard Announcement: Added the aeolynx_render_pro_tracking_workspace extensibility hook for the optional AEOLynx Pro companion plugin, plus a dismissible in-dashboard “What’s New” banner scoped strictly to the AEOLynx Overview screen (WordPress.org Guideline 11 compliant).
  • UI Polish: Fixed Overview hero circular gauge text overflow by moving status tiers into color-coded .wm-level-pill badges, unified score formatting across Overview and Agent Audit, aligned quick-start and audit toolbar buttons with uniform border-box sizing, and prevented sticky Settings savebar overlap.
  • Critical SEO fix (BUG-000): Scoped X-Robots-Tag: noindex headers strictly to /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, and /.well-known/* / /auth.md endpoints after route matching; normal HTML pages never receive X-Robots-Tag from the plugin.
  • Security fix (BUG-005): Excluded password-protected posts from /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, site Markdown, searchSite, getFeaturedContent, getCatalogItems, Schema_Graph JSON-LD, Schema_Builder, and local prompt mining, and added the aeolynx_exclude_post developer filter.
  • Security fix (BUG-009): Removed insecure ?api_key= URL query-string authentication; MCP API keys are now accepted via HTTP headers only (X-WebMCP-Key, X-AEOLynx-Key, or Authorization: Bearer).
  • Fixes (BUG-001 to BUG-041): Fixed archive canonical URLs and BreadcrumbList entity decoding (BUG-032/038); portable SQL rate-limit/throttle cleanup across MySQL, MariaDB, and SQLite (BUG-001); excluded cache/counter keys from revision invalidation (BUG-003); conditionally loaded frontend AI box JS/CSS only when rendered (BUG-004/018); strict DNS-AID validation (BUG-002); throttled crawler activity writes (BUG-006); preserved Cloudflare opt-in across Settings saves (BUG-007); cleaned transients, user meta, and rewrite_rules on uninstall/deactivate (BUG-008); added Retry-After on HTTP 429 and filterable trusted-proxy IPs (BUG-010/011); fixed well-known 200 headers and subdirectory routing (BUG-012); synced /auth.md and SKILL.md with API-key enforcement (BUG-013/014); fixed wp aeolynx audit CLI output (BUG-015); removed artificial 13-second audit delay (BUG-022); restored Audit JSON download and Overview Endpoint Inspector visibility (BUG-023/024); synced Content-Signal with Bot Policy presets (BUG-034); returned 404 for unresolved getPostContent URLs (BUG-037).

1.5.0

  • Public Bot Access reality check: the audit now verifies robots.txt, the MCP card, llms.txt and Agent Skills as an AI crawler sees them (GPTBot user agent) — catches host/CDN-level bot blocking that external scanners report.
  • Industry-strict scoring: audit score = passes ÷ all checks, matching external scanner methodology. Unverifiable checks report as UNVERIFIED, never as passes.
  • Deepened validation: ARD manifest requires the spec’s entries array, auth.md must describe agent registration/credentials, DNS-AID does a real DNS lookup, all audit fetches retry with a browser UA (WAF-resilient).
  • Deep-scan experience: the audit now shows a live radar-sweep animation with a staged checklist while 24 checks run, with a minimum scan duration so the process is visible.
  • Detailed report export: download the full audit report as JSON.

1.4.9

  • Renamed the plugin to “AEOLynx for WebMCP” (slug: aeolynx-for-webmcp); updated text domain, admin menu, endpoints, and External services documentation.

1.4.8

  • Settings toggles clear when unchecked; LiteSpeed_Cache_API used when available; mobile nav toggle and responsive admin layout.

1.4.7

  • Schema.org JSON-LD cleanup: pruned empty fields, single GET SearchAction, rejected placeholder FAQ answers.

1.4.6

  • GPLv2 license file, prepared uninstall SQL, Markdown Accept q-value negotiation with Vary: Accept and no-store.

1.4.5

  • Rewrote Agent Audit engine, added Public Bot Access (GPTBot) edge check, added ARD entries validation.

1.4.4

  • Fixed WP 6.7+ lazy translation loading for crawler-policy labels and Agent Audit partial include path.

1.4.3

  • Fixed infinite recursion on event logging, added browser-UA audit fallback, and removed simulated AI visit demo.

1.4.2

  • Added optional SHA-256 API keys, dual-window rate limiting, 4 KB payload cap, sandbox one-time tokens, schema & llms.txt caching, WP-CLI commands, and hardening headers.
